summary: This code defines a function that greets someone by name, or says 'Hello World!' if no name is provided. It then calls that function and prints the result.

explanations.5: This checks if the firstname variable is empty (an empty string means nothing was passed in).
explanations.8: The dot (.) operator concatenates strings together, so this joins 'Hello ' with whatever name was provided.
explanations.14: This calls sayHello() without passing any argument, so firstname will be empty and the function will return 'Hello World!'.
